spanish: Intercedan a Jehová, y bastante de ser voces de Dios y granizo, y enviaré a ustedes, y no añadirán permanecer.

findings.issue: Piel cohortative (will/desire to send) is smoothed to a simple indicative future.

notes: Tokens are represented in order, with ustedes forms for 2mp and Dios for אלהים.
